games.name: Tangram Dock
games.description: Fit three unusual cargo shapes into a perfectly packed dock.
rules: Choose a piece, then an empty square for its top-left corner.
Fill every square without overlaps. Remove a placed piece by choosing it again.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Mirror Mail
games.description: Deliver a beam through a tiny mirrored sorting room.
rules: Tap mirrors to turn them between / and \.
Send light from the left entrance to the bottom delivery port.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Bilateral
games.description: Restore the missing half of a woven reflection.
rules: The left pattern is fixed. Toggle squares on the right.
Match the exact horizontal reflection across the seam.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Shadow Turn
games.description: Turn four silhouettes until their shadows agree.
rules: Each large cutout turns one quarter clockwise when tapped.
Match all four cutouts to their small reference silhouettes.
Complete all three curated studies to finish the round.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Loose Ends
games.description: Exchange crossing points to untangle a knotted necklace.
rules: Select a point, then another point to swap their positions.
Remove every crossing between non-adjacent cords.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Gear Train
games.description: Build a reduction train with exactly the right output.
rules: Select two gears to swap them into the four sockets.
The paired shafts must deliver the target output ratio.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Measured Pour
games.description: Measure a precise parcel of water with two unmarked jugs.
rules: Fill, empty, or pour between the 3L and 5L jugs.
Leave exactly 4L in the large jug. Pours stop when full or empty.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Rover Script
games.description: Write a short route for a little delivery rover.
rules: Queue forward, left, or right commands; Run executes the route.
Collect the parcel and reach the flag without hitting walls. Clear edits your program.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Paper Trail
games.description: Fold a marked strip into one perfectly aligned stack.
rules: Fold the left or right half onto the other half.
Match the target top-to-bottom layer order after three folds.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Pigment Lab
games.description: Mix three transparent inks to a carefully measured shade.
rules: Add or remove drops of cyan, magenta, and yellow.
Match the recipe clues and the reference color exactly.
Complete all three curated studies to finish the round.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Cable Loom
games.description: Thread a cable through every brass peg in one stroke.
rules: Begin at S and tap a neighboring peg to extend the cable.
Visit every peg once, finishing at E. Undo retracts one segment.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Balance Mobile
games.description: Hang four weights to bring a kinetic sculpture to rest.
rules: Select a weight, then a hook. Choose a hung weight again to lift it.
Use every weight. Left and right torque must balance: weight × distance.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Crate Crane
games.description: Sort a little freight yard using only its top containers.
rules: Select a stack to lift its top crate, then a destination.
Stacks hold three crates. Make the left stack all A and the right stack all B.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Orbit Transfer
games.description: Navigate a one-way constellation while collecting every beacon.
rules: Travel along an available arrow from your current station.
Collect the three beacons, then dock at F before the 8-step fuel reserve runs out.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Stamp Studio
games.description: Compose a print from overlapping transparent stamps.
rules: Toggle stamps in the tray to overlay their ink.
Match the target print. Ink only adds: extra squares cannot be erased by another stamp.
Complete all three curated studies to finish the round.
games.controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

games.name: Minefield
games.description: Reveal the meadow without disturbing a mine.
rules: Reveal every safe square. Numbers count neighboring mines, including diagonals.
Switch to Flag to mark a suspected mine. Your first reveal is always safe.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Picross Post
games.description: A tiny picture, written in numbers.
rules: Numbers beside each row and column describe consecutive filled runs, separated by at least one empty cell.
Tap to fill. Tap again to mark empty, then again to clear. Check when your picture is ready.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Ninefold
games.description: Four numbers. Three kinds of harmony.
rules: Fill empty cells with 1–4. Each row, column and outlined 2×2 box must contain each digit once.
Choose a digit, then a square. Given digits cannot change.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Equal Measure
games.description: Bring dark and light into balance.
rules: Each row and column needs two suns and two moons. Never place three identical symbols consecutively.
Every row must differ from every other row, and columns must also be unique. Tap blanks to cycle symbols.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Taller Tales
games.description: Small signs make a big difference.
rules: Fill each row and column with 1–4 once each.
The signs between neighboring cells point to the smaller number. Given digits are fixed.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Code Cabinet
games.description: Listen to what the lock tells you.
rules: Find a hidden code of three symbols chosen from six; symbols may repeat. You have eight guesses.
A solid dot means correct symbol and position. A hollow dot means correct symbol, wrong position. Feedback dots are unordered.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Seat at the Table
games.description: There is a place for everyone.
rules: Arrange five guests in seats from left to right so all written clues are true.
Choose a guest, then a seat. A guest already seated moves to the new place, swapping occupants.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Sky View
games.description: Read a skyline from every angle.
rules: Place heights 1–4 once per row and column. A taller building hides every shorter building behind it.
Edge clues count buildings visible from that direction.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Bridgewater
games.description: Bring the islands together.
rules: Connect islands horizontally or vertically. Each island needs the number of bridges printed on it.
Tap a link to cycle zero, one or two bridges. Bridges cannot cross, and every island must join one connected network.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Loop Letter
games.description: One line. One unbroken thought.
rules: Draw a single closed loop along the grid edges. Each number counts the drawn edges around its cell.
Tap an edge to add or remove it. No branches, loose ends or separate loops.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Tent Pitch
games.description: Make room for a quiet night.
rules: Place one tent beside each tree horizontally or vertically. Every tent must be paired with a different tree.
Tents cannot touch, even diagonally. Edge numbers give tents required per row and column.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Pearl Route
games.description: Give every pair its own path.
rules: Join each matching letter pair with an orthogonal path. Paths cannot overlap.
Choose a letter, then tap neighboring cells to extend its path. Tap its starting endpoint or use Clear path to start that route again. Empty cells are allowed.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Tile Weave
games.description: A quarter-turn changes everything.
rules: Rotate tiles until every pipe connects with its neighbors, with no pipe pointing outside the board.
All tiles must form one connected water network. Tap to rotate clockwise.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Safe Passage
games.description: Unpack a small traffic jam.
rules: Move the red car to the right edge to escape. Cars slide only along their length and cannot pass through one another.
Select a car, then use the arrow buttons or keyboard arrows.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Cross Sums
games.description: Let the totals do the talking.
rules: Fill each white square with 1–9. Row sums appear on the left; column sums appear above.
No digit may repeat within a row or column. Any arrangement satisfying every sum is accepted.
games.controls: Tap or click cells and controls; Tab then Enter / Space works throughout. Arrow keys navigate the board.

games.name: Twenty Four
games.description: Combine four cards into a single perfect 24.
rules: Select two number cards in order, then an operation.
Each operation replaces both cards with its result. Use every card to finish at 24.
Undo lets you explore. Division by zero is never allowed.
games.controls: Tap or click two cards, then an operation. Keyboard: Tab and Enter / Space. Undo reverses a combination.

games.name: Merge Garden
games.description: Slide a garden of numbers into one brilliant 128.
rules: Use arrows or the four direction buttons to slide every tile.
Equal neighbors merge once per move. A new 2 or 4 grows after each legal slide.
Grow a 128 tile. If every cell fills with no possible merge, start a fresh garden.
games.controls: Arrow keys slide the garden. On touch screens, use the four direction buttons. Each slide is a turn.

games.name: Bit Lanterns
games.description: Light eight little lanterns to speak in binary.
rules: Each lantern contributes the number printed above it when lit.
Toggle lanterns until their total matches the target.
Send five increasingly complex signals. Extra checks cost points, never lives.
games.controls: Tap a lantern to toggle it. Keyboard: Tab to a lantern, then Enter / Space. The total updates instantly.

games.name: Fraction Balance
games.description: Find the combination that makes both pans agree.
rules: The left pan holds the target weight. Add fraction weights to the right.
Use at most three weights; tap a weight on the pan to remove it.
Balance exactly, then check. Different combinations may work.
games.controls: Tap a fraction to place a weight; tap a weight on the pan to remove it. All controls support Tab and Enter / Space.

games.name: Matchlight
games.description: Move one match. Make the whole equation true.
rules: Select one dark match to lift it. Then select one empty slot to place it.
Only one match may move. All digits must remain valid seven-segment numbers.
Check the repaired equation. Undo returns the original arrangement.
games.controls: Tap a match and an empty slot, or use the Lift / Place dropdowns. Keyboard: Tab, arrow keys in dropdowns, Enter to choose.

games.name: Factor Loom
games.description: Weave prime threads into one exact product.
rules: Each spool is a prime number. Choose spools to multiply them together.
Each physical spool can be used once. Tap a chosen spool to return it.
Make the target product exactly. Unused spools are allowed.
games.controls: Tap a spool to weave it in or return it. Keyboard: Tab and Enter / Space. Check when the product matches.

games.name: Clockwork
games.description: A few small jumps. One exact arrival.
rules: Start at twelve. Each button moves clockwise or counterclockwise around the dial.
Land on the marked destination using exactly the allotted jumps.
Undo a jump to plan another route. Crossing twelve wraps around.
games.controls: Tap a jump button to move around the dial. Keyboard: Tab and Enter / Space. Undo takes back one jump.

games.name: Fraction Mosaic
games.description: Fit colored pieces into a perfectly full ribbon.
rules: The ribbon has marked boundaries. Choose fraction pieces in the correct order.
Every placed piece must end on a marked boundary, with no gaps or overhang.
Fill the unit ribbon using the available pieces. Tap the last piece to take it back.
games.controls: Tap fraction cards to fit the ribbon in order. Remove last reverses a placement. Keyboard: Tab and Enter / Space.

games.name: Bracket Lab
games.description: One pair of brackets changes everything.
rules: The numbers and operators stay in their printed order.
Choose the first and last number to wrap in one pair of brackets.
Make the expression equal the target. Tap endpoints again to change your selection.
games.controls: Tap two number cards to choose the bracket endpoints. Keyboard: Tab and Enter / Space. Check the resulting expression.

games.name: Scale Sense
games.description: Find your bearings on a landscape of powers.
rules: The line runs from 1 to 1,000. Equal distances multiply by the same factor.
Move the marker with the slider or arrow keys, then commit your estimate.
Locate five magnitudes within a factor of 1.3. A miss reveals the direction; try again.
games.controls: Drag or tap the slider. Keyboard: Tab to the slider, then left / right arrows; Home / End reach the ends. Commit when ready.

games.name: Ratio Mixer
games.description: Compose a color with just the right proportions.
rules: Add coral and teal scoops to the jar. Each scoop is one unit.
Match the requested ratio and fill the jar to its exact capacity.
Remove scoops with the minus buttons to adjust your recipe.
games.controls: Use plus / minus beside each ingredient. Keyboard: Tab and Enter / Space. The jar shows your mixture as it fills.

games.name: Sequence Detective
games.description: A pattern is hiding in plain sight.
rules: Study the visible sequence and the clue describing its family.
Choose the missing number from four candidates.
Wrong guesses give feedback. Solve five different pattern families.
games.controls: Tap or click the next number. Keyboard: Tab between choices, then Enter / Space. Read the family clue before guessing.

games.name: Exact Change
games.description: A small basket. A satisfyingly exact total.
rules: Use plus and minus to choose quantities of three goods.
Spend the entire budget and buy exactly the stated number of items.
Prices are in cents, so your basket never suffers rounding surprises.
games.controls: Use plus / minus for each item, then Pay exactly. Keyboard: Tab and Enter / Space. Totals use exact integer cents.

games.name: Digit Forge
games.description: Arrange a handful of digits into something precise.
rules: Tap digit cards to build a number from left to right.
Use each card exactly once and satisfy both clues. No leading zero.
Tap the last placed digit to return it. Check when your number is complete.
games.controls: Tap digit cards in order. Take back last lets you edit. Keyboard: Tab and Enter / Space. Check once every card is placed.

games.name: Coordinate Courier
games.description: A tiny delivery route across the Cartesian plane.
rules: Collect numbered parcels in order at their printed coordinates.
Move one grid unit with arrows or direction buttons. x increases right; y increases up.
Reach every parcel within the step budget. Undo if you take a wrong turn.
games.controls: Arrow keys or the four direction buttons move one cell. Undo takes back a step. Touch the buttons to steer.

games.name: Hidden Grove
games.description: Find four words hidden along straight lines in a leafy letter grid.
rules: Tap the first and last letter of a word. Lines can run horizontally, vertically or diagonally, in either direction.
Find all four listed words. A wrong line costs 10 points. Tap the same square to cancel.
Use Tab and Enter, or arrow keys within the grid. No dragging or timer.
games.controls: Tap endpoints; arrows move focus; Enter selects.

games.name: One Letter Away
games.description: Bridge two words, changing just one letter at each step.
rules: Change exactly one letter to make a word in the open notebook. All words have four letters.
Reach the target from the starting word. The notebook is the complete allowed vocabulary for this puzzle.
Submit by typing and Enter. Undo a step if you take a detour. Invalid steps cost 10 points.
games.controls: Type four letters and Enter; Undo steps.

games.name: Last Letter
games.description: Guess a hidden word before six little leaves fall.
rules: Read the clue, then choose letters to uncover a hidden word.
Correct letters fill every matching position. A wrong letter costs one of six leaves. Repeating a guess is free.
Reveal the whole word to win. Six wrong letters end the round and reveal the answer.
games.controls: Tap letters or type A–Z.

games.name: Crossings
games.description: Fill three across clues and the down word that ties them together.
rules: Fill the white squares from four clues. Three across entries share letters with one down entry.
Type a letter in each square. Arrow keys move through the board; Tab visits white squares.
Check the completed grid. Correct letters turn green; wrong checks cost 10 points.
games.controls: Type letters; arrows move; Check grid.

games.name: Wordbreak
games.description: Find the spaces hiding inside a run of letters.
rules: Tap between letters to place or remove word boundaries.
Restore the sentence described by the clue. Capitalization and punctuation are already stripped away.
Check your spaces. Solve three phrases; wrong checks cost 10 points.
games.controls: Tap boundaries; Tab and Enter toggle.

games.name: Secret Post
games.description: Decode a letter-substitution message, one shared symbol at a time.
rules: Every cipher letter always stands for the same plain letter. Spaces are already in place.
Select a cipher tile, then a letter from the keyboard. All copies change together; each plain letter can map only once.
Check the message or ask for a revealed letter. Hints cost 20 points; wrong checks cost 10.
games.controls: Select cipher tile, type or tap letter; Backspace clears.

games.name: Center Letter
games.description: Build five clue words around one indispensable letter.
rules: Use only the displayed letters. Letters may repeat, but the green center letter must appear in every word.
Find the five curated clue answers. This small puzzle dictionary contains exactly these five words.
Type a word and press Enter. Duplicate answers are free; other invalid guesses cost 10 points.
games.controls: Type words and Enter; five clue answers.

games.name: Odd Company
games.description: Read the relationship and find the word that does not belong.
rules: Four words share a page; only three fit the stated relationship.
Choose the exception. A wrong choice stays on the page for another try and costs 10 points.
Solve three groups. Each reveal explains the distinction.
games.controls: Tap a word or Tab and Enter.

games.name: Alphabet Trail
games.description: Trace A to Y through an unbroken neighboring path.
rules: Start at A and visit B, C and onward to Y. Move only one square horizontally or vertically.
Every letter is used once. Diagonal or out-of-order moves cost 10 points without changing your path.
Undo your last step if needed. Arrow keys move focus; Enter chooses a square.
games.controls: Tap cells; arrows and Enter; Undo.

games.name: Sentence Studio
games.description: Reassemble a familiar saying from shuffled whole-word slips.
rules: Tap whole words to reconstruct the familiar saying named by the clue.
The capitalized first word and punctuated last word help frame the sentence. Tap an arranged word to return it.
Check your saying. Solve three; wrong checks cost 10 points.
games.controls: Tap word slips; Tab and Enter; Clear.

games.name: Compound Works
games.description: Join two halves into four everyday compound words.
rules: Choose a word from the left, then its partner from the right.
Every half is used once. Find the four familiar closed compound words for this set.
Correct pairs stay joined. Wrong pairs reset your selection and cost 10 points.
games.controls: Choose left then right; Tab and Enter.

games.name: Rhyme Lines
games.description: Match words by their ending sound, not their spelling.
rules: Choose a word on the left and its rhyming partner on the right.
Use ordinary English pronunciation. Every word belongs to exactly one pair in this set.
Find four pairs. Wrong matches reset selection and cost 10 points.
games.controls: Choose left then right; Tab and Enter.

games.name: Vowel Weather
games.description: Bring the missing vowels back to three clue words.
rules: Consonants stay in place. Every blank needs A, E, I, O or U.
Read the clue and type the whole restored word. Its consonants and length must match the pattern.
Restore three words. Wrong checks cost 10 points.
games.controls: Type the complete word and Enter.

games.name: Chain Reaction
games.description: Thread six words together by their first and last letters.
rules: The starting word is pinned. Choose a remaining word that begins with the last letter of the chain.
Use all six words once. Only the first and last letters matter.
Undo to escape a dead end. Invalid joins cost 10 points.
games.controls: Tap next word; Tab and Enter; Undo.

games.name: Proofreader
games.description: Spot the misspelled word and put the sentence right.
rules: Exactly one word in each sentence has a spelling mistake. Tap that word to edit it.
Type the correctly spelled replacement and submit. The other words are already correct.
Repair three sentences. Wrong selections or corrections cost 10 points.
games.controls: Select word, type correction, Enter.
